scientific_integrity: All structural claims follow from a fully specified finite simplicial complex, a complete acyclic face-poset matching, and exact signed simplicial Lefschetz character sums. Numerical experiments are not substituted for infinite-family claims.
scientific_limitations: One fixed twelve-vertex hexagonal prism; neither an all-prism theorem nor an integral group-lattice classification. Latest primary preprint version accessible in abstract only; first version sections read. Finite results reproduced exactly by bundled checker; independent mathematical validation not performed.
title: The hexagonal prism matching complex and its full dihedral-layer homology character
